summary: Both editions were reviewed independently against all eleven paragraphs of the selected Greek. They preserve the conditional sequence, thought/deed distinction, death assertion, required reception, repentance limitation, prohibition on remarriage, reciprocal application, and ability to heal. Reader-facing servant and contextual repentance follow current policy. Editorial supplements are distinguished from preserved wording. The frequency and image-making interpretations retain disclosed alternatives rather than claiming exclusive meanings; the reported witness differences are consistent with the supplied bounded evidence. Acceptance concerns fidelity to this working source and disclosure, not authentication of unseen manuscripts, exhaustive collation, or scholarly certification.
